nextStoryContext: US-016 added rate-limit pause/resume to the exit-mode worker path in src/supervisor/loop.ts, gated behind an optional rateLimitResume?: RateLimitResume injection (absent => zero behavior change). detectRateLimit(text) = /CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS=RATE_LIMIT/ OR isRateLimited(text) (reused from src/retry/patterns.ts). On detection the supervisor emits a 'rate-limited' WorkerEvent (events.ts WorkerEventKind gained 'rate-limited') with detail { phase: 'pause'|'resume', attempt, message }, awaits rateLimitResume, then respawns the SAME shellCmd (same uuid == --session-id, same channel marker => session continuity, AC4), re-waits and re-captures, bounded by maxRateLimitRetries (default DEFAULT_MAX_RATE_LIMIT_RETRIES=5). A resume-wait timeout reuses the normal timeout handling via a labeled `continue outer` (the outer supervisor while is now `outer:`); exhausting retries returns blocked 'rate-limit retries exhausted'. result.ts / WorkerOutcomeKind were intentionally NOT changed, so the sentinel-mode path keeps its prior behavior (a RATE_LIMIT there still reads as blocked). The production rateLimitResume (next.ts) reuses parseResetTime + calculateWaitMs from src/retry/time-parser.ts and Bun.sleepSync, capped at RL_MAX_SLEEP_MS (6h). Remaining non-operator story: US-017 (recovery runbook in docs/). US-018 requires:operator (real E2E). NOTE: implemented directly in a Claude Code session (no live -L cam worker pane in this checkout), not via a dispatched headless worker; no .cam-worker-US-016.session marker exists.
